summary: ThemeContext/Provider was added and ThemeToggle was refactored to consume it, but some requirements are not fully evidenced or are partially violated (notably DOM reads during render via matchMedia). The diff summary also indicates multiple unrelated UI/feature changes outside the requested theme/modal fixes.

missing_requirements.requirement: Refactor theme hook API to avoid DOM reads during render and ensure only one system-theme listener active only when theme==='system'.
missing_requirements.reason: ThemeProvider initializes effectiveTheme with window.matchMedia(...) inside a useState initializer, which executes during render (a DOM/browser API read during render). While documentElement.classList is not read during render, matchMedia is.

missing_requirements.requirement: Make the Home → Ritual History entry dialog content surface fully opaque (optionally with subtle backdrop blur) in both light and dark themes via className overrides at the call site (no edits under frontend/src/components/ui).
missing_requirements.reason: Home.tsx is truncated before any DialogContent/Dialog overlay className overrides are shown; the provided snippet does not include evidence of an opaque dialog surface being applied at the call site.

hallucinated_features.description: Changes to global dialog styling / modal surfaces via CSS (index.css) rather than only composing className overrides at the call site.
hallucinated_features.reason: The diff summary text claims index.css was updated with improved dialog overlay/content styling; this is not part of the requested approach for REQ-5 (which explicitly calls for call-site className composition, without touching shared UI internals).
